messages:
deploy-bot: rollout update: service=runtime-gateway image=redwood/runtime:2026-03-20-rc3 -> 50% of hosts. smoke checks scheduled.

maria: seeing repeated startup probe 503s on newly spun hosts within 30s of boot. pattern looks like kv-cache priming + cold-LLM weights. logs attached. :thinking:

sam: can you paste the failing probe output? worried this will cascade as we scale.

maria: sure, snippet below:

```
[2026-03-20T02:07:12Z] probe runtime-gateway-7f9c: GET /health -> 503 (startup)
[2026-03-20T02:07:18Z] probe runtime-gateway-7f9c: GET /health -> 502 (kv cache miss spike)
[2026-03-20T02:07:25Z] probe runtime-gateway-7f9c: GET /health -> 200
startup delay: 18s, first-success after cache fill
```

kevin: that's the warmstart priming I'm familiar with. rc3 changed the cold-cache init path and reduced early token prefetch. under bursty autoscale this pushes probes into 5-20s window.

sam: recommendation? do we pause rollout or bump probe timeouts?

maria: temporary options: 1) hold rollout at 50% and pin traffic to runtime:2026-03-19-stable, 2) increase healthcheck initial_delay from 2s -> 10s for the canary pool, 3) deploy a tiny hotfix that reintroduces early prefetch.

alyssa: ops calendar: we have a midnight change window at 02:00 UTC tomorrow if we need a coordinated hotfix + canary. if we hold now, we should update release notes and customer-facing release banner.

kevin: I prefer option 1 + schedule hotfix in window. safest for customer SLAs. pinning is quick: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-gateway=redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-stable --namespace=prod` and abort further rollout.

sam: +1 to pin and hold. I'll update the rollout bot. also adding a temporary synthetic probe that checks cold-start latency distribution to catch regressions during the hold.

deploy-bot: action queued: pause rollout for runtime-gateway at 50%, pin image -> redwood/runtime:2026-03-19-stable. change ticket #CHG-4721 created.

ops-bot: incident stub created: INC-2026-0319-WARMSTART with severity=low. assignees: @kevin @maria @sam.

maria: updating the release notes draft now, adding known issue: "startup probe 503s under autoscale for rc3; pinned to stable until 02:00 UTC hotfix window".

alyssa: please include rollback/hold reason and the ETA for re-eval (02:30 UTC after window) so SREs can clear pager. :memo:

sam: I'll send a short public note to #general and update the deploy dashboard. any objections?

kevin: no objections. after hotfix we'll re-run the synth probe with a 10k-request burst test and confirm 95th percentile warm-start < 25s before resuming.

maria: done - release notes updated, dashboard annotation added.

sam: thanks. holding until the window. follow-up thread will reference INC-2026-0319-WARMSTART and CHG-4721. :thumbsup:
